player_character.prompt: Generate a full-body, standing illustration of a cute, friendly messenger character in whimsical cartoon style, side profile view. The character should be small and adorable, approximately 80px tall, with a cheerful expression. Design them wearing a simple messenger outfit (like a tunic or vest) with a small satchel. Use warm, inviting colors like soft orange, yellow, or light green. The character should have rounded, simple shapes with a gentle outline. Style should be kawaii-inspired with big expressive eyes. Transparent background, game-ready game asset.
player_character.description: A cute, friendly messenger character in a neutral standing pose for the platformer game.

player_character_jumping.prompt: Change the pose of the character in image 1 to be jumping. The character should be in mid-air with arms raised upward and legs tucked slightly. Maintain the exact same design, colors, outfit, and art style as the character in image 1. Same side profile view, same size (~80px tall), same whimsical cartoon style. Transparent background. The expression should be excited and joyful. Game-ready game asset.
player_character_jumping.description: The cute messenger character in a jumping pose for the platformer game.

marshmallow_cloud_large.prompt: Generate a large, fluffy marshmallow cloud platform in whimsical cartoon style, side view. The cloud should be approximately 400px wide and 50px tall, with a soft, puffy appearance. Color should be white (#FFFFFF) with subtle pink tints (#FFE4E1) around the edges. The cloud should have a gentle, rounded shape with soft bumps suggesting fluffiness. Include a very subtle shadow on the underside for depth. Transparent background. Style should match a dreamy, kawaii aesthetic with soft edges and a slight glow effect. Game-ready game asset.
marshmallow_cloud_large.description: A large, fluffy marshmallow cloud platform for the game.

marshmallow_cloud_medium.prompt: Generate a medium-sized marshmallow cloud platform, identical in style to 'marshmallow_cloud_large' but approximately 250px wide and 45px tall. Same fluffy white appearance with pink tints, same soft rounded shape, same gentle shadow underneath. Transparent background. Maintain the exact same whimsical cartoon art style and color palette. Game-ready game asset.
marshmallow_cloud_medium.description: A medium-sized, fluffy marshmallow cloud platform for the game.

marshmallow_cloud_small.prompt: Generate a small marshmallow cloud platform, identical in style to 'marshmallow_cloud_large' but approximately 150px wide and 40px tall. Same fluffy white appearance with pink tints, same soft rounded shape, same gentle shadow underneath. Transparent background. Maintain the exact same whimsical cartoon art style and color palette. Game-ready game asset.
marshmallow_cloud_small.description: A small, fluffy marshmallow cloud platform for the game.

bouncy_mushroom.prompt: Generate a magical bouncy mushroom platform in whimsical cartoon style, side view. The mushroom should be approximately 100px wide and 80px tall. Features a large, rounded cap in vibrant purple (#9370DB) or blue (#6495ED) with small white spots, and a cream-colored stem. The cap should look slightly squishy and bouncy with a gentle shine. Add a subtle glow effect around the mushroom to suggest its magical bouncing properties. Transparent background. Style should be cute and inviting, matching the kawaii aesthetic of the other assets. Game-ready game asset.
bouncy_mushroom.description: A magical bouncy mushroom platform for the game.

star_crystal.prompt: Generate a collectible star crystal in whimsical cartoon style. The crystal should be approximately 40px in size, shaped like a four-pointed star with rounded tips. Color should be bright yellow-gold (#FFD700) with a radiant glow effect. The star should have a slight sparkle or shimmer to it, suggesting magical energy. Include subtle facets or shine marks to give it a crystalline appearance. Transparent background. Style should be cute and appealing, matching the dreamy aesthetic of the game. Game-ready game asset.
star_crystal.description: A collectible star crystal for the game.

sky_wizard.prompt: Generate a full-body illustration of a wise and friendly sky wizard character in whimsical cartoon style, side profile view. The wizard should be approximately 120px tall, wearing flowing purple robes with star patterns. Features include a long white beard, a tall pointed hat decorated with stars and moons, and a kind, welcoming expression. The wizard should hold a wooden staff with a glowing crystal on top. Use mystical colors: deep purple (#6A0DAD) for robes, white for beard, and gold accents. The character should look magical but approachable and friendly. Transparent background. Style should match the kawaii-inspired aesthetic of the other characters. Game-ready game asset.
sky_wizard.description: A wise and friendly sky wizard character for the game.

background_clouds.prompt: Generate a horizontal composition of 3-4 simple, fluffy clouds of varying sizes (ranging from 100-300px wide) for a background parallax layer in whimsical cartoon style. These clouds should be more transparent and less detailed than the platform clouds, with soft white and very light pink colors. They should look dreamy and atmospheric, suitable for slowly drifting in the background. Transparent background with the clouds having about 40% opacity. Style should be soft and gentle, enhancing the magical sky atmosphere. Game-ready game asset.
background_clouds.description: Distant, decorative clouds for the background parallax layer.

jump_sound.prompt: Light, bouncy jump sound effect with a whimsical, playful quality. Short (0.2-0.3 seconds), rising pitch, soft 'boing' or 'hop', magical cartoon-like. Cheerful tone, fantasy theme. One-shot.
jump_sound.description: A light, bouncy jump sound effect for the player character.

bounce_sound.prompt: Springy, energetic bounce sound effect for mushroom platforms. Slightly longer (0.3-0.4 seconds), strong 'sproing', magical shimmer/sparkle. Satisfying and rewarding. One-shot.
bounce_sound.description: A springy, energetic bounce sound effect for landing on mushroom platforms.

collect_star_sound.prompt: Magical, twinkling sound effect for collecting star crystals. Short (0.3-0.5 seconds), bright, sparkly. Gentle chimes or bells, rising pitch. Rewarding and delightful. One-shot.
collect_star_sound.description: A magical, twinkling sound effect for collecting star crystals.

victory_sound.prompt: Triumphant, magical fanfare for reaching the sky wizard. 2-3 seconds long, celebratory melody, whimsical, fantastical. Magical sparkle sounds, gentle chimes, uplifting progression. Conveys accomplishment and joy.
victory_sound.description: A triumphant, magical fanfare for reaching the sky wizard.

background_music.prompt: Gentle, whimsical background music, dreamy, magical atmosphere. Light and airy, soft instruments (bells, chimes, flutes, music boxes). Moderate, relaxing tempo (100-120 BPM). Peaceful sky-world ambiance. Simple, pleasant, loop-friendly melody. Duration: 60-90 seconds. Seamless loop. Style: fantasy, whimsical, dreamy, casual platformer.
background_music.description: Gentle, whimsical background music for the game with a dreamy, magical atmosphere.
